name: unsafe fn wrap_copy (& mut self , src : usize , dst : usize , len : usize)
rule: For safety, abs(dst - src) + len must be no larger than self.capacity(); the source and destination blocks must have at most one continuous overlapping region.
api: impl < T , A : Allocator > alloc::collections::vec_deque::VecDeque < T , A > { unsafe fn wrap_copy (& mut self , src : usize , dst : usize , len : usize) }
